scenarios.name: Read and dismisses the direct panel selector help

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full 3D Model ribbon visible
the user opens the direct panel selector
the user closes it with the same selector control
the Show Panels help tooltip appears
it explains that the down arrow displays more ribbon panels
it explains that selecting or clearing a checkbox adds or removes a panel
it offers additional help through F1
the user clicks empty viewport space
the 3D Model ribbon and part remain visible
